To rule out an over-constrained encoding I wrote an independent minimiser for the same family with cut-based connectivity instead of the single-commodity flow (all violated component cuts added per round); it agrees with MinTree on 9 of 9 comparable small configurations, and on this witness it converges in 2 rounds to the same optimal VALUE 1.0 by a different optimal tree (26 nodes, E=13, A=12, S=1) - and to 1.0 again on the level-restricted configuration, matching the rooted result. So two independent exact formulations agree that no tree of the counted family through this site costs 0 or less at c = 1. Per the task's own wording this refutes block 32's conjecture c* = 1 and, through the positive rooted cost, the induction hypothesis H3.
